title: Zendesk Reply via Audio Upload
breadth_reason: Tests ability to handle audio upload for CRM ticket reply with real Zendesk surface verification.

v7_target.engine: user-device engine installed on user's computer
v7_target.surface_rule: Actual signed-in Chrome profile with Zendesk ticket view
v7_target.proof_rule: Fresh surface capture showing Zendesk ticket with reply field visible

primary_user_input.reason: Uploaded audio ASR provides full transcription while avoiding live mic or paste-only shortcuts.

moments.description: User navigates to anticipy.ai/app and completes onboarding to download engine.
User's actual Chrome profile with signed-in Zendesk is verified.

moments.spoken_reference_text: Please add a comment to the Zendesk ticket for Hugo from this morning saying I am running fifteen minutes late to the dinner and will follow up after. If you cannot prove the visible Zendesk ticket or my signed-in workspace, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: User will say the phrase via audio upload using the /api/listen/upload endpoint; each run generates a fresh audio artifact.

moments.description: Engine checks that the ASR output matches expected text and that the user's surface is still accessible.

acceptable_outcomes.act: Reply posted on visible Zendesk ticket
acceptable_outcomes.ask: User prompted for confirmation if surface ambiguous

moments.description: Engine records that upload audio was primary; other input modes are unavailable.

success_criteria: Engine correctly transcribes audio upload and extracts intent.
Engine identifies the real Zendesk surface in the user's signed-in Chrome profile.
Engine posts the reply on the visible ticket if surface is verifiable, or declines cleanly if not.
Proof is captured from the actual browser tab, not from logs or stale sources.
No fallback to transcript paste or live mic is used.
failure_triggers: ASR fails to transcribe the spoken reference text accurately.
Zendesk surface is not signed in or ticket view is not visible.
Engine uses a stale screenshot or fake receipt to prove action.
Engine uses paste-only input despite audio upload being primary.
Decision is made without verifying the actual surface state.
